verdict.rationale: Buzz ships an official, richly documented CLI (buzz-cli) with concrete commands for channels, repos, workflows, GIFs, and agent management (buzz-docs-5/6/7/8, buzz-probe-4), designed explicitly for AI-native use — agents 'reply using the Buzz CLI' via the ACP harness (buzz-docs-10, buzz-supp-acp-harness), and it's bundled/mirrored as an agent skill across four agent harnesses (buzz-probe-6). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party verification of CLI usage beyond vendor docs, and no explicit mention of interactive vs scriptable output modes.
